requirements.quote: Add zod schemas in packages/validators/src/fees.ts (FeeAgreementInput, InvoiceInput, InvoiceLine, PaymentRecord, LedgerEntry, GstTreatment)
tables fee_agreement, invoice, invoice_line, payment, client_ledger_entry in packages/db/src/schema/fees.ts (workspace_id not null, RLS on app.workspace_id) with the next free migration
plus registry updates (packages/db/src/index.test.ts, rls/sql.test.ts, two-tenant seeders)
ADR docs/adr/0043-legal-gated-billing-flag.md (retention/anonymisation rules for ledger lines)

deliverables.change: New. Const arrays + zod: GST_TREATMENTS/GstTreatment enum, FeeAgreementInput, InvoiceLine, InvoiceInput (lines min 1), PaymentRecord, LedgerEntry. Money as non-negative safe-integer paise; strict objects; uuid ids; GSTIN via ./gstin pattern.
New unit tests: valid and invalid cases for each schema, unknown key rejected, negative or fractional paise rejected.

New. tenantTable definitions for fee_agreement, invoice, invoice_line, payment, client_ledger_entry copying packages/db/src/schema/client-contact.ts: composite (workspace_id,id) uniques, composite FKs to person/matter/each other, bigint paise columns, CHECKs via inList mirroring validators enums, ledger anonymised_at column, organization cascade FK on workspace_id.
Export the five tables next to clientContact (line ~325).

New <next-free-timestamp>_fees.sql generated by `pnpm --filter @causedeck/db db:generate`, plus hand-written ENABLE/FORCE RLS and ws_isolation policy per table (copy 20261026080832_client_contact.sql), header comments as there; updates meta/_journal.json and adds the meta snapshot. If the base took the timestamp, renumber.
Add the five table names to the root table list (near line 81).
Add the five tables to the RLS catalog (near line 224).
Add the five tables as DB_TABLES_TEST (near line 136).
Add TABLE seeders for the five tables (near line 1344), seeding the parent chain per tenant (person, matter, agreement, invoice).

New ADR following 0042 layout (Status, Date, Context, Decision drivers, Considered options, Decision, Consequences, Revisit when): billing behind legal-gated invoices.enabled flag, no money movement, ledger retention for the statutory period and anonymise-not-delete on erasure.
Add the 0043 index row after line 52 in the same format.

preserve.what: saas_invoice, saas_invoice_line, invoice_counter tables and names (packages/db/src/schema/saas-invoice.ts) are unchanged; new tables are named invoice/invoice_line.
Existing migrations and snapshots are untouched; the new migration is additive only (new tables).
Flag registry packages/flags/src/keys.ts and docs/engineering/flags.md unchanged (invoices.enabled already exists).
No runtime export is added to @causedeck/core and no 'use server' action, job or i18n namespace, so core/web/worker registries stay unchanged.

validate.command: pnpm --filter @causedeck/validators exec vitest run src/fees.test.ts src/client-contact.test.ts src/index.test.ts
pnpm --filter @causedeck/db exec vitest run src/index.test.ts src/__tests__/rls/sql.test.ts
pnpm --filter @causedeck/db exec tsx scripts/check-schema-conventions.ts && pnpm --filter @causedeck/db exec tsx scripts/lint-migrations.ts

decisions.choice: Money stored as bigint paise (mode number), not numeric
Tables named invoice/invoice_line, distinct from saas_invoice*
decisions.justification: packages/db/src/schema/saas-invoice.ts:2-3 reserves these names for client-fee invoices.

decisions.choice: Composite (workspace_id,id) uniques and paired composite FKs between the new tables
decisions.justification: db:check-rls requires FKs to tenant tables to pair workspace_id (saas-invoice.ts comment); pattern in client-contact.ts.

decisions.choice: No new workspace-package dependency: validators gets only a subpath export; db schema does not import validators (CHECK lists are mirrored consts, as client-contact.ts does)
decisions.justification: packages/db/src/schema/client-contact.ts:13 mirrors validators enums without importing them.
